unresolved.question: Surah 84 header box prints no Arabic surah name, so 'arabic' is null; the Bengali name is printed সূরা ইংশিক্ব-ক্ব.
Every band ২ on this page (rows 0, 1, 3, 5, 9) sits over a noon sakin or tanween before an ikhfa letter, not over a madd; labelled with this page's legend text for ② (দম ফেলিলে দুই আলিফ) anyway.
The ৬ beside each ringed-wedge (rows 0, 3, 7, 9) is printed inside a small ring at scan resolution; recorded enclosure 'circle'.

Rows 5-8: a ১ inside a single circle sits over the final alif of يَسِيْرًا, مَسْرُوْرًا, ثُبُوْرًا, سَعِيْرًا, بَصِيْرًا (tanween fath at the ayah end); recorded enclosure circle, label দম ফেলিলে এক আলিফ.

Row 7: the signs over the 84:14 verse circle and over بَلٰۤى are a small ج with three dots above (waqf mu'anaqah, explained in the right margin note); encoded as ۛ. Two solid down arrows in the band (over the 84:14 verse circle and after بَلٰۤى) are recorded with layer 'band'.
Row 0: the waqf sign after الْاَرَآئِكِ and the signs over most verse circles are a small لا, encoded ۙ; signs over circles 35, 5, 9, 12, 13, 15, 19 are a small ط, encoded ؕ.
